# testing_oas_maxlength (Resource)

OASMaxlength Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "testing_oas_maxlength" "my_oasmaxlength" {
  oneof_request              = ".."
  oneof_request_and_response = ".."
  oneof_response             = ".."
  request                    = "."
  request_and_response       = "...my_reques"
  response                   = ".."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `oneof_request` (String) oneOf request only maxLengths (union of 1 and 2)
- `oneof_request_and_response` (String) oneOf request and response maxLengths (union of 1 and 2)
- `oneof_response` (String) oneOf response only maxLengths (union of 1 and 2)
- `request` (String) request only maxLength (1)
- `request_and_response` (String) request and response maxLength (both 12)
- `response` (String) response only maxLength (2)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = testing_oas_maxlength.my_testing_oas_maxlength
  id = "..."
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import testing_oas_maxlength.my_testing_oas_maxlength "..."
```
